status: Recommendations only; no new datasets acquired or empirical superiority certified

experiments.study: A separately sealed, untouched time-series evaluation period
experiments.value: Directly tests the existing unfavorable baseline result without changing the released model
experiments.protocol: Freeze target periods, data vintage, training/validation history, model-selection rule, horizons and matched seasonal-naive baseline before opening new test values. Distinguish an untouched retrospective period from a genuinely prospective study. Do not reuse the exposed 2000–2023 benchmark as independent evidence.
requirements: Information-availability evidence or an explicit uncertified-vintage limit
Dependency-aware interpretation of overlapping forecast cells
experiments.correctness_risk: High if test exposure or data revisions are ignored

experiments.study: Preregistered future binary questions with independently resolvable outcomes
experiments.value: Provides genuine prospective records for the existing ledger and exact scoring interfaces
experiments.protocol: Lock unambiguous event definitions, cutoff/observation windows and resolution sources. Commit each probability and a fixed-half or prior-only reference-class baseline before outcome knowledge. Record unresolved, disputed and void questions explicitly.
requirements: Independent forecast commitment and time evidence
No model tuning on the evaluated outcomes
experiments.correctness_risk: High if resolution rules, missing outcomes or prior knowledge change after submission

experiments.study: Matched individual and fixed-pool forecasts on the same frozen questions
experiments.value: Tests whether aggregation helps on identical eligible targets rather than comparing different question sets
experiments.protocol: Use the prospective question protocol above. Collect permitted offline participant records; freeze equal or predeclared weights before outcomes. Preserve revisions, abstentions, missing participants and forecaster dependency groups. Compare on the exact common resolved sample.
requirements: No assumption that LLMs or related forecasters are independent
experiments.correctness_risk: High if versions are double-counted or forecaster dependence is ignored

experiments.study: Rights-cleared scalar sensor replay with recorded measurement availability
experiments.value: Can evaluate an existing state-space model against matched persistence and open-loop baselines
experiments.protocol: Separately approve an empirical Lab admission profile, pin units and parameters, and use only observations available at each update. Evaluate later targets against identical baseline origins; do not retroactively assimilate delayed measurements.
requirements: A lawful dataset and timestamp/vintage evidence
experiments.correctness_risk: High if arrival time is confused with observation time

experiments.study: A separately approved held-out trial-window classification study
experiments.value: Would test feature classification without claiming unrestricted intention prediction
experiments.protocol: First obtain lawful consent, data rights and a distinct empirical profile; do not relabel real EEG as synthetic. Freeze feature construction, subject/run/trial groups, window overlap rules and TRAIN-only model decisions. Keep TEST labels isolated until scoring and use matched simple baselines.
requirements: New empirical ingestion/admission profile; currently deferred
experiments.correctness_risk: High for leakage, privacy, preprocessing and unsupported clinical or intention claims
